title: M24e private string-facts v2 typed concat
x-semanticRules: Exactly one explicit .ts module and the exact minimal-scalars-v2.d.ts content/hash; distinct canonical absolute paths beneath sourceRoot; rootFile selects the .ts; declarations selects the .d.ts.

Validate strict UTF8/RFC7493 JSON, duplicate/unknown members, no unpaired JSON surrogate, single value; v2 request and output require exact JCS+oneLF. The --string-facts-io-v2 selection accepts only request version 2; v1 selection and data remain unchanged.

Recompute exact UTF8 file SHA256/byteLength and UTF16 lengths; require distinct files sorted by UTF8 path bytes in request and output. The payload retains sourceRoot/config/declarations and reconstructs the exact canonical version-2 request.

All Source official diagnostics precede owned capability selection. Project every top-level named directly exported zero-parameter non-generic function in declaration order, with one explicit primitive string return signature and one return statement. Every return expression is exactly BinaryExpression PlusToken with direct ordinary StringLiteral left and right; no mixed literal-only returns or other declarations.

Official checker proves both operand StringLiteral types and each raw literal value equal to its AST literal.Text; the binary result and declared return are primitive string. Preserve the stringConcat operation and its left/right operands; do not evaluate, concatenate, fold, normalize or publish a result string/codeUnits.

Ranges are half-open UTF16 source offsets from official nodes: declaration excludes leading trivia, return includes an explicit semicolon when present, concat covers exactly left start through right end, operatorRange is the one plus token, both quotes are included in each literal. ASI may end return at concat end.

All owners join their actual declaration/export and sourcePath. Require 0<=declaration.start<return.start<concat.start=left.start<left.end<=operatorRange.start<operatorRange.end<=right.start<right.end=concat.end<=return.end<declaration.end<=source UTF16 length; operatorRange.end=operatorRange.start+1 and that source UTF16 unit is plus. Non-overlapping functions retain source order. Boundaries cannot split a source surrogate pair.

Each literal codeUnits array is required and owned, 0..65535, length<=16384. Count both operands independently including equal repeated values; per concat left length+right length<=32768; sum every operand across the package<=65536. Empty [] is retained; no null/omitted/result arrays or cross-owner deduplication.

Enforce byte/depth/token/string/source/function/operand/aggregate budgets before typed array allocation/copy, canonical output and hash preimages. JSON Schema alone cannot prove actual byte counts, aggregate sums, source token ownership or official semantic equality.

schemaHash=sha256 of this complete schema JCS+oneLF. requestId=sha256(UTF8("tsfg.string-facts.request.v2\u0000")+exact canonical request JCS+oneLF). packageId=sha256(UTF8("tsfg.string-facts.package.v2\u0000"+schemaHash+"\u0000")+payload JCS without LF). Prefix identities sha256:. The \u0000 notation in this rule denotes one actual NUL in each hash preimage; self-consistent identity never proves official semantics.
